classification: preregistered parameter-neighborhood audit of the R332 candidate; no parameter selection
discipline: No TopN, asset, defensive weight, cost or gate changes.
Each variant is recomputed from the same cached A/B strategy curves and trades; no new strategy search.
Do not select the best grid cell.

fixed_rules.equity_sleeves: A/B Top10, 60-day A/B inverse-vol risk parity, A share [0.2,0.8]

known_limitations: This is an in-sample neighborhood audit, not independent out-of-sample proof.
ETF qfq and current industry snapshot limitations remain.

plateau_rule.center: 60d/15% center must pass and remains the reported candidate
plateau_rule.failure_action: if either plateau threshold is missed, downgrade R332 to research_only_parameter_fragile and do not keep the paper-review status
plateau_rule.joint: at least 2 of 3 joint target variants must pass every variant gate
plateau_rule.overlay: at least 7 of 9 lookback/target variants must pass every variant gate

purpose: Test whether the R332 candidate is a knife-edge or sits on a stable 40/60/90-day and 12/15/18% volatility plateau. The delivered choice remains the center 60d/15% regardless of which neighbor has the highest return.

variant_gates.asset_substitution: all three R331 single-asset substitutions pass annual >=5%, MDD >= -20%, 2022/2023 >=0
variant_gates.bootstrap: 252-day block bootstrap positive rate >=80% and P05 >= -12%
variant_gates.concentration: C1-C12 from R331 with the same thresholds
variant_gates.fresh_starts: at least 4/5 positive and every MDD >= -18%

joint_target_grid.description: Change the A/B composite and overlay volatility target together at the fixed center lookback.

overlay_grid.description: Change only the equity-vs-defensive-bucket lookback and overlay volatility target.
